snippet.title: Club Penguin - iPad App Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Club Penguin - iPad App Official Trailer

The next big update is almost here! iPad users will be able to download the app for free in the Apple App Store beginning Thursday, December 12. 

http://www.clubpenguin.com

Play Club Penguin: 
http://play.clubpenguin.com

Check out what's new on Club Penguin on our blog:
http://www.clubpenguin.com/blog

Subscribe to Club Penguin on YouTube: 
http://puffl.es/subscribecpyoutube

Like Club Penguin on Facebook: 
https://www.facebook.com/clubpenguin

Follow Club Penguin on Twitter: 
https://twitter.com/clubpenguin

-------------------------------------------------------

The Official Club Penguin Youtube channel has been deleted on December 20th 2018. Club Penguin Archives does not own any of these videos.
